name: continue-openrouter
description: Autocomplete and NextEdit powered by OpenRouter - bring your own API key and model.

continue.openRouter.model.description: The OpenRouter model ID used for autocomplete and NextEdit completions. Defaults to a small free-tier model so the extension works on a free OpenRouter account without credits. Autocomplete fires on nearly every keystroke, so a small, fast model usually feels better than a large, slow one. Paid models (e.g. "anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet") give higher quality but require credits on your key. See https://openrouter.ai/models for the full catalog. Your API key is set separately via the "Continue: Set OpenRouter API Key" command.

enumDescriptions: Enable NextEdit only when the selected model supports it (currently Mercury Coder and Instinct). Otherwise use standard inline autocomplete.
Always enable NextEdit. Only meaningful for a NextEdit-capable model - a general chat model will produce no suggestions at all.
Never enable NextEdit; always use standard inline autocomplete.
continue.nextEdit.enabled.description: Controls the NextEdit multi-location edit prediction feature. NextEdit requires a fine-tuned model (Mercury Coder or Instinct); standard inline autocomplete works with any model.

continue.modelTimeout.description: Milliseconds to allow a completion to keep streaming. The upstream default (150) was tuned for local models and truncates hosted-API completions to a single line. Raise this if you use a slow model and see cut-off suggestions.

commands.title: Continue: Accept Jump to Next Edit Location
Continue: Reject Jump to Next Edit Location

scripts.package: npm run build:prod && node scripts/prepare-native-deps.js && vsce package --no-dependencies && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/inject-native-deps.ps1
